'''July 2001 Pleasanton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Pleasanton, California on 14 July 2001. [[Kevin Shannon]] won it. It is known from Kyle Ishimaru's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2641">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-15-pleasanton-7-14-01d2641/ pleasanton-7-14-01], DeckTech (Kyle "Psyokid" Ishimaru, 15 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-15-pleasanton-7-14-01d2641/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Pleasanton, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Kevin Shannon]]
